note: This file is a pure configuration file containing only dictionary and list variable assignments. It defines optimizer settings (AdamW with weight decay), learning rate scheduling (LinearLR warmup + CosineAnnealingLR), and training parameters (300 epochs, batch size 1024) for HiViT pretraining on ImageNet. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs — only configuration variables (optim_wrapper, param_scheduler, train_cfg, val_cfg, test_cfg, auto_scale_lr) intended to be imported by MMPreTrain's config system.
